name: run_command
description: Run a shell command (/bin/sh -c) in the workspace, e.g. tests or git status. It runs inside a sandbox: it can write only inside the workspace, has no network, cannot read the home folder or secret files, and starts with an empty environment (HOME is a temporary folder). There is no input; interactive commands will not work. Returns exit_code and output (long output keeps its start and end). The user approves every command.

command.description: The shell command, e.g. "pytest -q". Pipes and && are allowed

cwd.description: Folder to run in, relative to the workspace. Default "."

timeout_seconds.description: Stop the command after this many seconds. Default 60, max 300
